थिएटर और बॉलीवुड की दुनिया से आई है एक बेहद शानदार और दिल छू लेने वाली खबर! 🎭

दिग्गज अभिनेता अनुपम खेर को भारतीय थिएटर में उनके बेहतरीन योगदान के लिए शनिवार को प्रतिष्ठित Natsamrat Balgandharva Award से नवाजा गया है।

अवॉर्ड मिलते ही अनुपम खेर ने Instagram पर एक भावुक हिंदी पोस्ट शेयर की। उन्होंने इस जीत का श्रेय खुद लेने के बजाय यह सम्मान नाटक के पीछे काम करने वाले बैकस्टेज वर्कर्स को समर्पित कर दिया।

उन्होंने लाइट, साउंड, कॉस्ट्यूम और टिकट काउंटर पर काम करने वाले क्रू मेंबर्स के साथ-साथ अपने लंबे समय से साथी रहे असिस्टेंट Dutta Sawant का भी विशेष धन्यवाद किया।

हाल ही में उन्होंने अपने मशहूर नाटक Jaane Pehchaane Anjane का US और Canada में एक बड़ा North American tour भी पूरा किया था।

यही नहीं, ऑन-स्क्रीन भी वह एक्टिव हैं और हाल ही में Ramayana: Rise of a Legend में Jatayu और Sooraj Barjatya की फिल्म Yeh Prem Mol Liya में Ayushmann Khurrana और Sharvari के साथ नजर आए हैं। ✨

क्या आपने अनुपम खेर की कोई फिल्म या उनका प्ले देखा है? हमें कमेंट्स में जरूर बताइए! 👇

ctx.text:
Veteran actor Anupam Kher has been honoured with the Natsamrat Balgandharva Award for his contribution to Indian theatre. The actor received the recognition on Saturday and shared his gratitude in a Hindi note on Instagram, dedicating the award to the many people who work behind the scenes to bring a theatrical production to life.
In his post, Kher acknowledged the contribution of crew members across different departments, including those responsible for lights, sound and costumes. He also mentioned the people who manage ticket counters and guide audiences to their seats, pointing out that a play's success depends on the collective efforts of everyone involved.
The actor also spoke about the significance of receiving an award named after Balgandharva, whose contribution to Indian theatre has inspired generations of performers. For Kher, the recognition carried added meaning because of his admiration for the theatre legend and the legacy he left behind.
Kher also made a special mention of his longtime assistant, Dutta Sawant, thanking him for his continued support and for managing the responsibilities associated with his plays.
The honour comes shortly after Kher completed the North American tour of his play Jaane Pehchaane Anjane , which travelled across venues in the US and Canada. The production marked another chapter in the actor's continued association with theatre.
Kher has also been active on screen this year. He recently appeared as Jatayu in Ramayana: Rise of a Legend and is currently seen in Sooraj Barjatya's Yeh Prem Mol Liya , which also stars Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari. The film adds to his association with Barjatya, having worked with the filmmaker on several projects over the years.
